reason: The hypothesis directly restates the intervention, mechanism, and predicted outcome already demonstrated in P5 and P9 for the quinary WTaCrVHf alloy, merely proposing a slightly higher Hf content (~7 at% vs. 7.5 at% in P9) and framing the known result as a prediction. The core idea is taken from a single line of research (P4, P5, P9, P39) without combining findings from different papers or introducing a new mechanism.
